messages.subject: Internal Error when moving Project to another computer
parts:
Hi, I am using the new Distance to teach design simulation at a Population Ecology Course.

I developed a project and exported it to a pendrive to move it to the student´s PCs.

When they open the project, they receive the message of the screen picture attached. It seems that Distance looks the geographic data where I originaly stored the database file in my PC, ignoring where the files are stored in the new PC. Both dst file and dat folder ae in the same place in the new PCs.

I can´t see in Dstance how to correct it i fthere is an option to do so. Any clue?

messages.subject: {Disarmed} Re: [distance-sampling] Internal Error when moving Project to another computer
parts:
Adrian/Ana

Because of the distinct nature of the two error messages, my first guess is that these are different problems; one having to do with file location and the other to do with ActiveX components.  Adrian, can you place your project onto a cloud server or something so that I can pretend to be one of your students?  Perhaps that way I can diagnose the problem, but not until late Friday.

Your message does not describe what version of Distance you and your students are using.  I'll be using the most recent version of Distance for my investigation.

Eric Rexstad
